Privacy Policy of "First Car Out"

Offline casual slide-puzzle mini-game

Update Date: November 3, 2026 Effective Date: November 3, 2026

This Policy is formulated by the developer of the mini-game "First Car Out" (hereinafter referred to as "the Developer") to govern the processing of your personal information.

1. Information Processed by the Developer

As required by law, the Developer only processes the information necessary to implement game features.

To save your game progress, the Developer stores game progress data (level progress, star ratings, etc.) locally on your device. Such data remains on your device only and is never uploaded to the Developer's servers.

This game requires no registration or login, and the Developer does not collect your nickname, avatar, phone number, ID number or any other personal information. Any information generated from your use of your Douyin platform account is processed by the platform operator in accordance with its officially published privacy policy.

2. Third-Party Plug-in / SDK Information

To display advertisements, the Developer integrates the official ad plug-in provided by the Douyin Open Platform. The personal information processing rules of the third-party plug-in are subject to its officially published statements. The third-party plug-in integrated into this game is as follows:

Plug-in name: Douyin Open Platform Official Ad Component (Interstitial Ads)

Plug-in provider: Douyin Mini-Game Platform Operator

To deliver ad content to you, this plug-in may collect device identifier information, ad display and interaction data, etc., subject to its official statements.

3. Storage of Information

The Developer promises that, except as otherwise provided by laws and regulations, your information will be retained for the shortest period necessary to achieve the purpose of processing.

The Developer stores your information locally on your device (within mainland China).

4. Rules on the Use of Information

The Developer will use the collected information only for the purposes expressly stated in this Policy.

If the Developer needs to use your information beyond the purposes or reasonable scope stated in this Policy, the Developer must inform you again by means such as pop-up notifications and obtain your explicit consent before changing the purpose or scope of use.

5. External Provision of Information

The Developer promises not to actively share or transfer your information to any third party. Where sharing or transfer is truly necessary, the Developer shall directly obtain, or confirm that the third party has obtained, your separate consent.

The Developer promises not to publicly disclose your information. Where public disclosure is truly necessary, the Developer shall inform you of the purpose of the disclosure, the types of information to be disclosed and the information that may be involved, and obtain your separate consent.

6. Your Rights and Contact Information

You may manage or withdraw your authorization to the Developer via the following path: top-right "…" on the game home page — "Settings" — tap the specific item — tap "Don't Allow".

With respect to your personal information, you may contact the Developer through the following channel to exercise your statutory rights of access, copying, correction and deletion.

Email

y0102456nl@163.com

If you believe the Developer has failed to comply with the above commitments, or if you have any complaints, suggestions, or questions concerning the protection of minors' personal information, please contact the Developer via the channel above.

First Car Out Dev Team · This Policy applies to the mini-game "First Car Out" and all of its level content
